title: the frozen proposal request and response contract of the api freeze
description: freezes the proposal request the endpoint receives and the plan proposal the protocol parses: the request carries the objective, the session record, the observation and the capability report while the response carries the versioned envelope, the plan and the optional resume, lock and agent markers; the response refuses every version outside the frozen protocol version.

objective.description: the plain language objective the user reviews

session.description: the session record of the requesting session as the session schema freezes it

observation.description: the observation payload as the observation schema freezes it

capabilities.description: the capability report as the capability schema freezes it

proposalresponse.description: the frozen plan proposal fields of the versioned envelope

version.description: the frozen protocol version of the versioned envelope

plan.description: the agent plan as the plan schema freezes it

resumedfrom.description: the checkpointed step ids a resumed proposal marks

agentid.description: the fleet agent that requested the plan
